title: PCSO Lotto Results: 6/42 prize now P71M with no winners in October 1 draw
summary: There were no winners of the two major lotto draws on October 1, 2026 as the Lotto 6/42 jackpot prize climbed to over P71 million, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on…

blocks.text: There were no winners of the two major lotto draws on October 1, 2026 as the Lotto 6/42 jackpot prize climbed to over P71 million, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Thursday.
No bettors picked the winning combination of 40-13-35-10-15-14 for the Lotto 6/42 prize of P71,399,823.97.
The odds of winning the jackpot in a standard 6/42 lottery game are 1 in 5,245,786.

It was also better luck next time for Superlotto 6/49 since no bettor selected the correct numbers of 39-03-43-04-42-15 to win the P30,902,608.81 prize.
According to the PCSO, the odds of winning the Super Lotto 6/49 jackpot are 1 in 13,983,816.
